messages:
jana: heads up — ran into weird auth + retry behavior when running js-sdk in Deno edge runtime (fresh checkout of examples/edge-chat). Tokens refresh fine in node, but in deno the SDK hits 401 then fails to retry. Repro steps below, anyone seen this? :thinking_face:

sam: hmm, quick q — is this using the fetch shim or native fetch in deno? also which SDK version?

jana: Deno 1.37, bun not involved in this run. SDK @redwood/js 0.12.0-canary. Using native fetch (no fetch-shim). The flow: init client with tokenProvider that does async refresh. logs:
```
fetch /v1/generate 401
retryMiddleware: got 401; calling tokenProvider
tokenProvider returns new token
retryMiddleware tries request again -> still 401
```

micah: that smells like the retry middleware reading Authorization header from original Request object that is immutable in Deno's Fetch API. In node we mutate headers; in Deno you need to create a new Request.
\njana: yeah suspecting same. Deno's Request.headers is frozen? I saw TypeScript types for Headers are readonly in lib.deno.ns.d.ts, and that might cause the code path to bail.

igor: cc @devx-bot — quick patch idea: in retry path do `req = new Request(req, { headers: new Headers(req.headers) })` and set auth header on that new request before re-dispatch.

sam: also watch web crypto — if tokenProvider signs with subtleCrypto and returns Uint8Array vs base64 string, types mismatch can cause token to be invalid but not obvious. We had a similar onboarding bug in sample apps.

jana: confirmed making new Request fixes it locally. Will open a tiny PR. Also noticed Bun behaves differently: its fetch allows header mutation but types don't complain, so bug only shows in Deno.

devx-bot: deploy check triggered for patch branch jana/deno-retry

devx-bot: CI: deno tests running on deno-lint, deno-test

sam: can we add a unit test that runs in deno runtime matrix and asserts retry mutated auth is used? might be flaky but worth.

micah: also add a note in the SDK readme about 'immutable request objects in edge runtimes' and recommended tokenProvider shape for async refresh.

jana: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/212 — includes fix + test + readme blurb. adding sample snippet for Bun/Deno compatibility.

igor: thanks! once green we should backport to 0.12.x patch since customers on Dedicated saw this on a POC.

sam: small reminder — when editing retry logic, consider idempotency headers and streaming requests; creating new Request for body streams can be tricky. Maybe disallow retry for non-rewindable bodies or buffer small ones.

jana: noted. Thanks all :heart:
